dex.entry: A colossal glacier-hermit whose geode shell has become a literal ice-cave it carries. The crystal interior is now large enough to shelter small kin in blizzards — some say Frostkit families nest inside willing Vaultclaw shells. Its claws can carve new passages through glacier ice. A walking crystal

art.silhouette: Large, powerful crustacean body; the carapace is now a massive dome of geode and ice-crystal formations, towering above the body; huge armoured claws; a walking glacier-cave silhouette — dramatic and distinctive at 48px, dominated by the crystal dome above.
